benchmark_scope.description: Bounded sample of 11 named major road corridors: eight core motorway/federal-road references and three strategic road-scope tests.
benchmark_scope.road_policy: motorway/trunk/primary including links; secondary and smaller roads require an explicit, source-supported exception. National road numbering alone does not establish OSM road class.
benchmark_scope.selection: Six major Bas-Rhin axes in ADEUS Note 345, plus Goldene Bremm and four southern Rhine road corridors. This is not an exhaustive France–Germany frontier census or Schengen checkpoint list.
benchmark_scope.denominator_limit: Selected benchmark recovery is not full-frontier recall; reference corridors and raw directional road contacts use different counting units.

sources.title: Trafic transfrontalier : le Pont de l’Europe dans les parcours routiers (Note 345)
claims: Six studied Bas-Rhin road axes: Lauterbourg/A35, Roppenheim/D504, Gambsheim/D502, Pont de l’Europe, Pflimlin/M353, Marckolsheim/D424.
limitations: A selected traffic study, not an exhaustive frontier crossing register. Counts are historical traffic observations, not evidence of closure or current operating status.
sources.locator: Printed page 2, axes and counting points map and discussion

sources.title: Situation der grenzüberschreitenden deutsch-französischen Rad- und Fußwege, Drucksache 15/5565
sources.publisher: Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure, published by Landtag Baden-Württemberg
claims: Identifies Iffezheim/Roppenheim B500, Rheinau-Freistett/Gambsheim L87, Europabrücke B28/N4, Pierre-Pflimlin L98/N353, Sasbach/Marckolsheim L113/D424, Breisach B31/D415 and Neuenburg/Chalampé B378/D39.
limitations: Transport-ministry response concerns cycling and walking connections alongside roads. Use named road connections only; 2014 access conditions and road numbering are not asserted as current.
sources.locator: Response to question 1, printed pages 3–4; response dated 12 September 2014, issued 19 September

sources.title: Sanierungsbedarf der Brücken in den Landkreisen Waldshut und Lörrach, Drucksache 17/8661
sources.publisher: Ministry of Transport, published by Landtag Baden-Württemberg
claims: Identifies the Palmrheinbrücke/Palmrain crossing on B532 at Weil am Rhein as France–Germany.
limitations: Source also lists Switzerland–Germany bridges; those are not part of this pair. No numerical crossing coordinate is supplied.
sources.locator: Answer to question 7, printed page 6; response dated 2 May 2025, issued 8 May

sources.title: Autobahn GmbH rechnet mit einem der verkehrsreichsten Wochenenden des Jahres
claims: Lists the A6 segment between the French frontier and Saarbrücken Goldene Bremm.
limitations: A dated traffic forecast used only for corridor identity. It does not establish current traffic restrictions or a precise frontier coordinate.
sources.locator: Printed page 3, motorway table A6 row

sources.title: Verkehrssicherheit auf der Bundesstraße 9 zwischen Kandel-Süd und Lauterbourg, Drucksache 12/8048
sources.publisher: Ministry of Economy, Transport, Agriculture and Viticulture, published by Landtag Rheinland-Pfalz
claims: Identifies B9 between Kandel-Süd and the Lauterbourg frontier crossing.
limitations: Historical road identity corroboration only; accident counts, design and operating conditions are not treated as current.

sources.title: Stützpfeiler an der L87 über den Rhein bei Rheinau werden saniert
claims: Confirms the L87 barrage-road corridor between Rheinau-Freistett and Gambsheim alongside the separate walking/cycling bridge.
limitations: Construction notice supports the road and locality relationship only; it is not imported as a closure event.

sources.title: Rheinbrücke bei Breisach (B31/D415, Breisgau-Hochschwarzwald) wird überprüft
claims: Names the Breisach Rhine road bridge and B31/D415 routes.
limitations: Dated maintenance announcement is used for corridor identity only; historical construction restrictions are not added to the workbook.

sources.title: Kleinere Bauarbeiten an der B378 bei Neuenburg am Rhein
claims: Identifies B378 and the bridge approach toward Chalampé at Neuenburg.
limitations: Approach works and a relocated traffic counter are not a surveyed frontier point or closure-event evidence.

sources.title: Transports et itinéraires – Les 5 ponts de l’Eurodistrict
sources.publisher: Eurodistrict Region Freiburg – Centre et Sud Alsace
claims: Names the Ottmarsheim–Steinenstadt road bridge connecting A36 and A5; also distinguishes Breisach, Chalampé and Marckolsheim road bridges.
limitations: Undated regional-authority transport overview, not a current crossing-status inventory; local Hartheim/Fessenheim crossing is outside this bounded sample.

sources.title: Décret n°2009-615, routes à grande circulation, article (60 à 69)
claims: Department 68 entries connect D39 to the German frontier at Chalampé, D105 at Village-Neuf and D415 at Vogelgrun.
limitations: Consulted dated consolidation route list for identity only; road category in French law is not an OSM highway class.

crossings.name: Goldene Bremm motorway crossing
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Motorway corridor only. Do not substitute the nearby B41/Metzer Straße crossing or the police-office location.

crossings.name: Lauterbourg–Bienwald road crossing
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Named A35/B9 corridor; distinguish the separate local crossing.

crossings.name: Iffezheim–Roppenheim Rhine crossing
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Rhine barrage road corridor; do not substitute a nearby canal bridge.

crossings.name: Gambsheim–Rheinau-Freistett crossing
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Tests a major corridor numbered as a German Landesstraße; this numbering alone does not imply an OSM secondary-road exception.

crossings.name: Europabrücke / Pont de l’Europe
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Road bridge only; exclude adjacent tram, railway and pedestrian bridges. N4 is a historical reference in the 2014 source.

crossings.name: Pierre-Pflimlin bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: M353 appears in 2025; N353 in 2014. A numbered Landesstraße can still be a main-road OSM candidate.

crossings.name: Sasbach–Marckolsheim road bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: The Sasbach road bridge is distinct from the Burkheim walking/cycling barrage crossing.

crossings.name: Breisach–Vogelgrun road bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Use Rhine frontier bridge; the same route subsequently crosses separate canals.

crossings.name: Chalampé–Neuenburg road bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: Road component of the Rhine crossing; nearby rail geometry is not a second road facility.

crossings.name: Ottmarsheim–Steinenstadt motorway bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: A5 is the connecting German motorway. The Rhine frontier bridge is distinct from the A36 bridge over the Grand Canal d’Alsace.

crossings.name: Palmrain bridge
crossings.coordinate_basis: No defensible numeric frontier coordinate published in the reviewed primary sources; no town centroid or OSM-derived coordinate used as independent truth.
crossings.notes: France–Germany road bridge; exclude the nearby pedestrian Dreiländerbrücke and Switzerland–Germany crossings.
